inviteForm.title: Invite a team member
inviteForm.description: Send an invitation to join this workspace.

memberList.heading: Members ({count})

removeDialog.title: Remove member
removeDialog.description: Are you sure you want to remove {name} from the workspace? They will lose access to everything in it.

transferDialog.title: Make {name} an owner?
transferDialog.description: {name} becomes an owner, with full control of this workspace, its billing and its members. You stay an owner until you leave. An owner can't be demoted or removed from this page.

memberList.emptyHint: Invite someone above to share this workspace.

pendingInvitations.heading: Pending invitations ({count})

cancelDialog.title: Cancel this invitation?
cancelDialog.description: The invitation link sent to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.

pendingInvitations.emptyHint: Invitations you send appear here until they're accepted.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.description: Give up your access to {workspace}. Someone there has to invite you again for you to come back.
leave.dialogDescription: You lose access to everything in this workspace right away. If you're its only owner, make another member an owner first.

errors.memberLimitReached: Your plan's seats are all taken. Upgrade to invite more people.
errors.memberLimitReachedCount: Your plan includes {limit, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}}, and they're all taken. Upgrade to invite more people.
errors.soleOwner: You're the only owner of this workspace. Make another member an owner before leaving.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.acceptVerificationFailed: We couldn't confirm the invitation. Please try again.
errors.providerError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
